item.title: Utility Reconnection Fee Explained: Cost to Restore Service After Shutoff
item.description:
Quick Answer: How Much Does It Cost to Reconnect Utility Service After Shutoff?

A utility reconnection fee typically runs $20–$60 for electric, $25–$75 for natural gas, and $25–$60 for water during regular business hours — and $75–$200+ more for after-hours or weekend restoration. You must pay the full past-due balance plus the reconnection fee (and often a new utility deposit) before the utility will turn your service back on. With a smart meter, restoration can happen in under 2 hours; otherwise, expect same-day service if you pay before the utility’s afternoon cutoff, or next business day after that.
